messages:
anna: Quick QA — final Product X launch post is on preview. Need a fast pass on hero, benchmark framing (narrative, not a lab report), CTA + UTMs, and webinar routing. Target publish Tue 9am PT.

cj: On it. Link?

anna: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/1778889990 — focus on hero heading, the benchmark blurb, and the top CTA mapping to the webinar.

marco: Hero draft: 'Make inference predictable at production scale' 1  clear and product-forward.

ellie: That reads well. For benchmark, instead of raw single-number claims, can we say: 'In Dedicated runs we saw stable throughput with typical p50 latency around 90-110ms and p99 within acceptable production bounds on our eval suite.' That gives signal without sounding like an absolute.

marco: Love the framing. Add a short parenthetical for reproducibility: "(test config: 6xA100, seq_len=384, mixed-batch eval)" — collapse on mobile.

cj: Ops: what UTMs + HubSpot hidden fields should we use for hero CTA vs bottom CTA? We need server-side tagging for direct link clicks too.

ops-bot: Suggested UTMs: hero CTA -> utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=prodx_launch_jun2026; bottom CTA -> utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=prodx_launch_jun2026. HubSpot hidden fields: campaign=prodx_launch_jun2026, lead_source=blog, product_interest=dedicated. Will add server-side tag 'prodx_launch_jun2026' for direct clicks and map webinar signups to tag 'webinar_prodx_jun2026'.

anna: Perfect. Include hidden field 'marketing_channel=blog_post' for attribution and make sure Sales Ops gets a webhook on webinar signups.

ops-bot: Confirmed  will add hidden field and Sales Ops webhook.

ellie: Legal check: avoid comparative language and absolutes. Replace 'best' or 'always' if present. Also add privacy copy near the webinar form: 'We process personal data according to our Privacy Policy.'

legal-bot: Quick scan done — phrase "within acceptable production bounds" looks fine. Flagged two instances of "guarantee" in an earlier draft; removed. Happy to do a short final pass once copy freeze is posted.

marco: One micro ask for design: include a placeholder customer quote and a compact benchmark thumbnail. Placeholder text: '"Product X helped us stabilize latency and simplify scaling" (placeholder)'.

ellie: SEO micro: add keywords 'dedicated inference' and 'inference latency' to the subhead and meta description. Also add schema.org/Article tags on publish.

anna: Done. I pushed the edits to the preview and added the UTMs per ops. Preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/1778889990.

deploy-bot: preview deployed at https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/1778889990  expires in 48h :rocket:

marco: I'll wait for the final assets, ETA 60-75m after copy freeze.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: apply server-side tag and hidden fields at publish time. Also will add a server rule to ensure direct CTA clicks set contact property 'source=blog' if not present.

ellie: I'll coordinate with content to slot the webinar time in the hero CTA copy ("See Product X in action — Wed, Jul 14, 9am PT"). Confirm date before we schedule.

anna: Plan: lock copy by 4:00pm PT, legal final pass at 4:10pm, ops to wire tags, design to deliver assets, schedule Tue 9am PT publish. Tagging @legal-bot when copy freeze is up. Thanks all! :tada:
